statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; ∀ n, MeasurableSet (wideArcs n)

plain_statement.zh: wideArcs(n) 是 Borel 可测集。

brief.zh: 把存在量词展开为可数个有理邻域的并；每个邻域是闭区间。
brief.en: Expand the existential as a countable union of rational neighborhoods; each is a closed interval.
